Element.attribute:
This work product defines the data requirements to execute the test effort. Examples of requirements to address test data needs include:

  • Will production or synthetic data be used?
  • How much data is needed?
  • When is the data needed?
  • Where does the data need to be located?

Note: Justifications for using production or synthetic data are usually provided.
To communicate the requirements for test data needed to implement test execution.

Topics typically covered in this artifact include, but are not limited, to the following:

  • Test data requirements
  • Source of the test data including relevant criteria to extract a specific subset of data
  • Test scripts associated with the test data criteria
